hypothesis.method: Neuroevolution of Augmenting Topologies (NEAT) with brain-inspired synaptic plasticity rules applied to transformer-based language models
hypothesis.problem: Language models fail to generalize efficiently to novel domains despite massive parameter counts
hypothesis.goal: Achieve dynamic architecture adaptation during training that improves out-of-distribution generalization and reduces catastrophic forgetting
